budget: 3 spec candidates per view, every --check run on a distinct spec counts

attempts.note: same structure as the final spec but both edge labels long. tb rank gaps cost (label chars - 1) rows, so extent hit 46 rows: one row of margin left, no room for any repair.

FINAL. 'LAN client' shortened, so extent drops to 62x43 and the graph fits with margin. Trunk is one bus (oob -> bmc_c) with two spurs (bmc_s, pwr) = three destinations, and --check prints '1 junctions'. Three destinations cannot be encoded any other way in this build: the trunk's `to` plus `branches` must be distinct nodes, so 3 destinations means 2 spurs, which selects the hub split. The hub's cost is one raw warning: the bus's own port cell and hub cell are shared by its routes. A 4-destination probe (3 spurs) printed '3 branches, 3 junctions' with no warning, and that shape is not available for three destinations.

engine_calibration_probes.note: Not case candidates: throwaway specs used to measure renderer behaviour before committing a view. Raw outputs were not kept; the measured numbers are quoted here and in generation.md.
raw: tb rank gap costs (len(label)-1) rows: 2-node tb chain extent 15x12 unlabelled, 15x14 at len 3, 15x19 at len 8, 15x24 at len 13.
lr rank gap costs the same amount in columns: 23 wide unlabelled, 25 at len 3, 30 at len 8, 35 at len 13.
trunk junction model: spurs<=2 -> one hub junction (1 junction) and a shared-run warning; 3 spurs -> one tap per branch (3 junctions) and no shared-run warning.

groups: a single-member group draws no titled region in tb but a displaced empty box in lr; a multi-member group draws a bordered titled region, and an arrowhead crossing the top border overwrites a title glyph.

note_on_rejected_attempts: Rejected-attempt spec files were overwritten by later drafts; their raw --check output is preserved verbatim in checks/. No hash is reported for a spec that was not kept.
